_comment: Source files retrieved from the org that contain hardcoded credentials. They stay in local source (needed for development) but are excluded from Git by TVM/.gitignore and blocked by scripts/secret_scan.py. Remove an entry only after the credential is moved out of the code (e.g. to the TP named credential), rotated in the org, and the file passes the secret scan. See 05-Conflicts CON-002.
